De-identify a survey dataset

Source: R/deidentify.R
deidentify_vcs.Rd

Applies the whole privacy pipeline in one call: removal of direct identifiers, deterministic hashing of the identifiers needed for linkage, geographic coarsening and optional date shifting.

deidentify_vcs(
  x,
  remove = NULL,
  hash = character(0),
  salt = NULL,
  geography = list(round_gps = NULL),
  age_bands = NULL,
  shift_dates = FALSE,
  max_shift_days = 30L,
  drop_raw = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

A vcs_data object.

remove

Columns to delete outright. Defaults to the direct identifiers the dictionary names.

hash

Identifier columns to replace with deterministic pseudonyms.

salt

Secret salt, required whenever hash is non-empty or shift_dates = TRUE. Read it from the environment; never hard-code it.

geography

Arguments passed to generalize_geography(), as a list. NULL disables geographic treatment.

age_bands

Breaks passed to generalize_age(). NULL leaves age alone.

shift_dates

Shift dates with shift_dates().

max_shift_days

Maximum absolute date shift.

drop_raw

Drop the preserved raw import, which still contains the identifiers. TRUE by default, and it should stay TRUE for anything that leaves the data-management team.

Value

x, de-identified, with a deidentification element recording what was done (but never the salt).

Details

The salt is used and discarded. It is never written to the output data, the de-identification report, the object's metadata, or the console.

See also

identify_pii(), assess_reidentification_risk()

Examples

# In production, read the salt from the environment:
#   salt <- Sys.getenv("VAXSURVR_SALT")
anon <- deidentify_vcs(
  vcs_example,
  hash = c("child_id", "household_id"),
  salt = "example-salt-not-for-production"
)
anon$deidentification
#> $actions
#> [1] "removed direct identifiers: child_name, caregiver_name, telephone, address"
#> [2] "hashed identifiers (salted SHA-256): child_id, household_id"               
#> [3] "coarsened geography"                                                       
#> 
#> $salt_used
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $salt
#> NULL
#> 
#> $timestamp
#> [1] "2026-10-02T16:33:17+0000"
#> 
#> $vaxsurvR_version
#> [1] "0.2.0"
#> 
head(anon$children$child_id)
#> [1] "3667F1B3DB3D" "B851BAE00235" "2764EBA1FB46" "FAEB9F60ABF6" "E94C71B10058"
#> [6] "4BB611983BFF"
